methods_quotes.q: Proportion estimation methods used a complex survey design with statistical weights to correct potential biases
Each submitting laboratory source was considered a primary sampling unit
Weights account for the probability that a sample from an infection is sequenced and are trimmed to the 99th percentile.
multinomial regression models were fit for national and regional estimates to nowcast
the doubling time of each variant was calculated using the “time” covariate in nowcast models
Variant proportion estimates that did not meet the National Center for Health Statistics’ data presentation standards for proportions were flagged.
